scope: isolated actual-APK bootstrap performance diagnosis, no Activity analysis
reviewer_model: GPT-6 Codex; exact runtime identifier unavailable

first_entry.basis: frozen ApplicationBootstrap javap orders constructor first; diagnostic contexts=1; observed stack processJob->writer

sampling_limit: Top30 distinct stacks retained; counts are not fractions of all samples or exact CPU attribution.
root_cause: First processJob evaluates reflection.writer(target), which lazily invokes discoverFields over all indexed methods. That discovery runs plans/flow.summary/decode and second-pass map/subtype predicates under shared/global deadline rather than host.localDeadline in frozen v13.
minimum_generic_boundary: Propagate caller localDeadline through discovery, summary decode and expensive per-method/per-call operations.
Do not mark partial discovery complete or cache partial negatives after expiration.
Prefer cheap exact Map put signature checks before repeated type hierarchy queries, with bounded/cached hierarchy work.
Static-discovery work may be shared; its accounting and initialization must be explicit rather than hidden in an atomic method context.
limitations: Single run only; concurrent batch load differs from original15.3857s.
Sampling helper uses10ms daemon and adds overhead; CPU/wall near-equality supports CPU-bound work rather than queue waiting.
No claim all bootstrap missing state is due only to performance.
Production source changed while sampling; frozen jar javap is authoritative for this diagnosis.
